newsitem.title: DENMARK: GN Store Nord, BellSouth take over Sonofon.
newsitem.headline: GN Store Nord, BellSouth take over Sonofon.

text.p: Danish cable group GN Store Nord said on Wednesday that it and U.S. ally BellSouth had bought Swedish firm NordicTel's minority share in Danish mobile phone operator Sonofon.

A statement from GN Store Nord, which raised its Sonofon holding to 51 percent last August, said that the partners paid approximately 600 million Danish crowns -- after tax reductions -- for Nordictel's 20 percent, giving them full ownership.
The bulk of Nordictel's shares pass to BellSouth, which will now hold 46.5 percent of Sonofon, while GN Store Nord's stake rises only slightly, to 53.5 percent.
A statement from NordicTel in Stockholm put the sale price at 680 million Danish crowns and said it expected net proceeds of 465 million Swedish crowns.
